column1: # Format: id<TAB>operation<TAB>input<TAB>expect  (# starts a comment line)
# The table describes the default Windows configuration
# (`punctuation_commit = false`). The setting-on branch of the Windows client is
# Windows-specific and deliberately not modelled here.
# Windows evidence for the default composition path:
# Android evidence before the shared source:
# A pending romaji tail must be finalized first (`n` + punctuation is ん + mark).
# ---- Shifted symbols that commit the composition on Android -------------------
# Windows has no immediate-commit key path: these append to the composition and
# follow the width settings. Recorded here so the drift stays visible.
# Punctuation and digits join the reading instead (2026-11-10 fix).
# ---- Digits join the composition (Windows UserAction::Number -> AppendText) ----
# Fullwidth digits never come from the number key path.
